Meet the team

Zeta Labs was founded by Asha Rao and Vikram Mehta in 2019. Our Series A round was led by Peak XV Partners with participation from Chiratae Ventures.

Asha Rao, Co-founder & CEO

Previously led payments at Razorpay.

Vikram Mehta — CTO

Vikram built our stack on Kafka, PostgreSQL and Kubernetes.

Neha Iyer, Head of Talent

Neha runs hiring.

Qdrant raises $50M

Berlin-based Qdrant, the open source vector database company, announced today that it raised a $50 million Series B. The round was led by AVP with participation from Spark Capital and Unusual Ventures.

Qdrant was founded by Andre Zayarni and Andrey Vasnetsov in 2021. Its competitors include Pinecone and Weaviate. The company partnered with Microsoft to offer managed clusters.

Andre Zayarni, CEO of Qdrant, said the funds will grow the engineering team.

Backend Engineer

We're hiring a backend engineer. Apply now. You will build services in Python and Go on top of PostgreSQL and Redis, deployed with Docker on AWS.

Responsibilities include designing APIs with FastAPI.

Priya Nair

Priya Nair is a senior data scientist who works on fraud detection models for online payments. Priya Nair studied at IIT Madras before joining the payments team. She writes about machine learning, risk scoring and experimentation for the Razorpay engineering blog.

Our portfolio

For over two decades Accel has partnered with exceptional founders building category-defining companies. Accel has invested in Freshworks, Swiggy and BrowserStack, among many others across software and consumer internet in India and around the world.

Zomato completes Blinkit deal

Food delivery company Zomato acquired Blinkit in an all-stock deal, adding a quick commerce business to its platform. Blinkit was founded by Albinder Dhindsa, who will continue to lead the business from Gurugram as it expands its network of dark stores across Indian cities.

How we scale our platform

Millions of developers depend on our APIs every day, so reliability is our first engineering principle. Our stack is built for that: we use Kafka for event streams, Kubernetes for orchestration and PostgreSQL for our core metadata store, with careful capacity planning across regions.

Speakers

Meet the founders and operators sharing their stories at this year's summit on building and scaling technology companies in India.

Kunal Shah, Founder of CRED

Kunal speaks about trust and consumer behaviour.

Nithin Kamath, CEO at Zerodha

Nithin speaks about bootstrapping a brokerage.

Freshworks and Google Cloud expand partnership

Freshworks partnered with Google Cloud to offer AI agents to mid-market customers. The companies will co-sell the new service desk agents in North America, Europe and India starting next quarter, with data residency options for regulated industries.

Pinecone review

Pinecone is a managed vector database used for semantic search and retrieval. In the market, Pinecone competes with Weaviate and Milvus, which both offer open source options that teams can run on their own infrastructure or as a hosted cloud service.

What is retrieval-augmented generation?

Retrieval-augmented generation is a type of information retrieval that grounds a language model's answer in documents fetched at query time. It combines a retriever, often built on embeddings and a vector database, with a generator that writes the final answer.

Backend Engineer

We're hiring a backend engineer to build trading and investment services used by millions of Indians. You will work with Kafka and AWS, design APIs, and own services end to end. Apply now if you enjoy distributed systems and high-traffic products.

How to Build a World-Class Quant Team

Quant teams combine research, engineering and trading. We look at how leading firms organise them.

The D.E. Shaw Group

We next take a look at The DE Shaw Group, which is a global investment and technology firm. It was founded in 1988 by David E. Shaw, a computer scientist. The fund has about $60 billion AUM.

Two Sigma

Two Sigma was founded in 2001 by computer scientist David Siegel and mathematician John Overdeck. The fund has over $58 billion AUM.

The final group that we will look at is Citadel Securities, which was founded in 1990 by Kenneth C. Griffin.
